english.note: Use this for the gentle, mild-tempered side of docility, especially when someone or an animal is easy to handle rather than merely following a particular instruction.

examples.english: That cat is very docile; even when I hold it to trim its nails, it doesn’t struggle.
examples.traditional: 嗰隻貓好溫順嘅，抱住佢剪指甲都唔會掙扎。
